src_sentence: guḍḍena gomayena viśuddhena ca vāriṇā oṃ āḥ vajjrarekhe ha~ iti maṇḍalādhiṣṭhitabhūbhāge caturastrādi caturṇāmanyatamama- bhimatamaṇḍalakaṃ kṛtvā tanmadhye viśvavarṇāṣṭadalakamalavaraṭake stūryamaṇḍalopari naulaha~kārapariniṣpannaṃ bhūsparśamudrādharaṃ kṛṣṇavarṇa akṣobhyam, tadanu pūrvvadale śukta oṃkāra niṣpannaṃ śuktavarṇaṃ bodhyaṅgī (grī) mudrādharaṃ vairocanam, tato dakṣiṇadale pautacā~kārajaṃ pautavarṇaṃ varadamudrādharaṃ ratnasambhavam, tataḥ paścimadale raktahī~ḥ kārasambhūtaṃ raktavarṇaṃ samādhimudrādharaṃ amitābham, tata uttaradale śyāmaba~kārajaṃ śyāmavarṇa- mabhayamudrādharamamoghasiddhiṃ ca bhāvayitvā, oṃ āḥ vajtrapuṣye hū~ ityanena abhimanvya savrvvamiṣṭataraṃ ḍhauṃkayet
